content: Claude Code has a sandbox based on Bubblewrap. However, the lean-lsp-mcp tools are not executed inside the sandbox, so it is possible to use them to escape the sandbox. Would it be possible to run the Lean server for lean-lsp-mcp inside Claude's default sandbox?
How does this work in other agentic environments?

You can use lake build inside of bubble wrap aka use the Lean / Lake CLI. This is also what Kim recommends #Machine Learning for Theorem Proving > OpenCode @ 💬 . Generally Models are fairly good with the CLI.
Hm, I find interacting with the server significantly faster than running lake build as a bash command.
For example, if the file imports Mathlib, then each lake build will spend about 3s just on the import, I have much better experience with the LSP tools.
